lines.en: Mia, you look pale. Were you tired because you had been working late again?
lines.pt: Mia, você está pálido. Estava cansado porque vinha trabalhando até tarde de novo?

lines.en: Yes, I had been preparing the budget since Friday because the deadline was Monday, and I had not slept properly.
lines.pt: Sim, eu vinha preparando o orçamento desde sexta porque o prazo era segunda, e não dormi direito.

lines.en: No wonder you fell asleep. Our manager had been watching you for ten minutes before she said anything.
lines.pt: Não admira que você tenha dormido. Nossa gerente vinha observando você por dez minutos antes de dizer algo.

lines.en: Oh no. I had been trying to look interested, but the room was warm and the slides were boring.
lines.pt: Ah, não. Eu vinha tentando parecer interessado, mas a sala estava quente e os slides eram chatos.

lines.en: Don’t worry. She was not angry, because she had been through the same thing last year.
lines.pt: Não se preocupe. Ela não ficou brava, porque já passou pela mesma coisa no ano passado.

lines.en: Really? I thought she had been working here forever, with that calm attitude of hers.
lines.pt: Sério? Achei que ela trabalhava aqui desde sempre, com aquela atitude calma dela.

lines.en: She has, but she had been working twelve hours a day when we moved to Collins Street, and she burned out.
lines.pt: Trabalha, mas ela vinha trabalhando doze horas por dia quando mudamos para a Collins Street, e teve um esgotamento.

lines.en: That explains why she told me to rest. She said I had been pushing myself too hard.
lines.pt: Isso explica por que ela me mandou descansar. Disse que eu vinha me forçando demais.

lines.en: Exactly. Last month our intern was exhausted because he had been covering two jobs, and nobody had noticed.
lines.pt: Exato. No mês passado nosso estagiário estava exausto porque vinha cobrindo dois cargos, e ninguém tinha notado.

lines.en: So I should speak up before I get that tired. I had been too proud to ask for help.
lines.pt: Então devo falar antes de ficar tão cansado. Eu estava orgulhoso demais para pedir ajuda.

lines.en: Exactly. Tomorrow, tell her what you had been doing all week, and ask for more time.
lines.pt: Isso. Amanhã, conte a ela o que você vinha fazendo a semana toda e peça mais tempo.

facts.label: Causas no passado
facts.sub: A causa duradoura vai para had been + -ing: She was tired because she had been working. Pergunta: Why had you been…? Negativa: hadn’t been.

facts.label: Causa → efeito
facts.sub: Use o past perfect contínuo para a causa e o passado simples para o resultado: He was exhausted because he had been covering two jobs. A causa vem antes e durava um tempo.

facts.label: Duração
facts.sub: Acrescente for ou since para mostrar quanto tempo: I had been preparing the budget since Friday. We had been waiting for two hours. Assim a explicação fica mais clara.

pages.title: Too tired to listen · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Tuesday morning in a glass office in the middle of Melbourne. The phones are already ringing. Rui sits at his desk with dark circles under his eyes. His colleague Owen brings two cups and sits next to him. Yesterday, Rui fell asleep during an important meeting. Now Owen wants to understand what had happened.

“Rui, you look pale. Were you tired because you had been working late again?” says Owen. “Yes, I had been preparing the budget since Friday because the deadline was Monday, and I had not slept properly.” says Rui. “No wonder you fell asleep. Our manager had been watching you for ten minutes before she said anything.” says Owen.

opts: I was tired because I had been working all night.
I was tired because I worked all night and I am still tired.
I was tired because I was been working all night.
items.why: Use had been + -ing for the cause before the result.

opts: She said she had been working since Monday.
She said she is working since Monday.
She said she was working since Monday.
items.why: In reported speech, use had been + -ing with since.
Put had before the subject in a question.

opts: He had been tired for a week.
He had been feeling tired for a week.
He had been tiring for a week.
items.why: With adjectives like tired, use feeling or had been.

extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Escolha a frase mais natural. → I was tired because I had been working all night.
Escolha a frase mais natural. → She said she had been working since Monday.
Escolha a frase mais natural. → Why had you been sleeping?
Escolha a frase mais natural. → He had been feeling tired for a week.
